## AI Review Checklist

- [ ] AI-assisted output was reviewed by a human.
- [ ] Any accepted AI suggestions were checked against the repo and tests.
- [ ] Any rejected AI suggestions that affected the work were recorded in the prompt journal.
- [ ] No real client, tenant, credential, or controlled data was included in prompts, code, tests, logs, or docs.

## Reviewer Checklist

- [ ] Correctness: behavior matches the PR description and handles relevant edge cases.
- [ ] Security: auth, validation, and data-handling posture are not weakened.
- [ ] Observability: errors and logs are useful without exposing sensitive data.
- [ ] Tests: happy paths and relevant negative paths are covered or explicitly not applicable.
